title: Untitled (Discs and Targets)
description: Dense layered collage incorporating multiple compact discs, concentric target rings, and bold red vertical and horizontal ribbon stripes across a fragmented paper ground. Black tape, iridescent foil, green star bursts, and a red cross anchor the composition amid overlapping geometric and circular elements.
composition: Vertical layered stacking with horizontal red bands
keywords: concentric bullseye and compact disc assembly
